label: v3: Reactor Core
history: v1: first draft. Dais radius 7.5 with nine socket pillars, rib dome, central pedestal, three spinning rings and an equator ring that carries the inserted seals, core sphere.
v2: everything twice as large (scale 2), shorter central pedestal, smaller tilted ring_b.

v3: Reactor Core after the concept page v6_reactor: freestanding block built reactor of copper, steel, brass, andesite and hazard stripes, nine pylons with colour slots, glowing conduits, caged glowing cube between two emitters, three spinning block rings. Same footprint 30 x 26 x 30.
